texts.facts: The petitioners have approached this Court seeking a direction to the respondents to consider their application for regularisation in respect of two buildings bearing Nos.CC8/2712-U/A (old No.12/1541) and CC 8/2711-UA (old No.12/1540-A). There is a further prayer for a direction to the respondents to consider and pass orders on Exts.P10 and P12 representation and application, as also to accept the building tax in respect of the two buildings aforementioned, pending consideration of the regularisation application. It is also his submission that the property tax in respect of the two buildings can also be accepted by the respondents, pending disposal of the regularisation application. Taking note of the said submission, the writ petition is disposed by directing the respondents to pass orders on the application for regularisation preferred by the petitioners in respect of the two buildings aforementioned, within an outer time limit of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment, after hearing the petitioners.
